_about: Read by src/gate/gate.ts; see the README, "Coverage gate". exempt and unauthenticated need a reason per entry. backlog is what no scenario covered when the gate landed: it only shrinks, and the gate fails on an entry a scenario now covers.

exempt.DELETE /gateway/chats/{room_id}/agents/{: Switch Console group chats. exempt.POST /gateway/rooms/{room_id}/sync-name: Needs a bridged room whose linked channel was renamed on the platform, which the fast lane's stacks cannot stage. Covered by core's test_room_sync_name.py against real Postgres.
exempt.PUT /gateway/chats/{room_id}/read: Switch Console read positions. Covered by core's test_chats_groups.py against real Postgres; no scenario drives Console chats yet (every other /gateway/chats route is still in the backlog).
exempt.WS /gateway/changes/ws: Console's change-notice socket. What it sends is covered by core's test_changes_socket.py, and the session probe checks it refuses a handshake without a session; no scenario drives Console's lists yet.
exempt.get_template_status: Needs an agent created from an official template on a managed machine and then a newer revision of that template; no stack the harness builds has managed agents yet (create_agent is in the backlog). Covered by core's test_template_updates.py.

unauthenticated.GET /gateway/agents/known-types: The catalogue of agent types this server can register and their option schemas; no tenant data. Public since the initial import, and nothing records whether that is deliberate.
unauthenticated.GET /gateway/auth/config: Read by the login page before any session exists, to choose which sign-in methods to offer.
unauthenticated.GET /gateway/auth/oidc/callback: The OIDC sign-in round trip, before any session exists.
unauthenticated.GET /gateway/auth/oidc/login: The OIDC sign-in round trip, before any session exists.
unauthenticated.GET /gateway/docs: FastAPI's generated docs, served without a session. They publish the gateway's whole route list and schemas to anyone who can reach it.

The third-party sign-in round trip: the flow is identified by its state, not a session.
unauthenticated.POST /gateway/auth/logout: Only clears the session cookie; there is nothing behind it to protect.
unauthenticated.POST /gateway/auth/oidc/exchange: Trades a code from an OIDC sign-in for a session, so it runs before one exists; the code is good only with the PKCE verifier its challenge was made from, and only while fresh.
unauthenticated.POST /gateway/auth/signup: How an account, and its first session, is created.
